code_lines_original: % GPS_SIMULATOR  Interactive GPS dynamics simulator (MATLAB R2019b or newer)
%   * Tab "MATLAB Functions" : the code that implements each equation + explanation
%   * 3D view                : 24-satellite constellation (ECEF frame), user, pseudorange lines
%   * Bottom plot            : 3D position error and PDOP versus time
%     6. Simulation logic (callbacks, main loop, one time step)
%     7. Local math functions (the actual GPS equations)
% 24 satellites: 6 planes x 4 satellites (simplified Walker-like layout)
orb.Omega(idx) = deg2rad(60*(k-1));                   % RAAN of the plane
% Simulation state (shared with the nested functions below)
histLen = 300;  tHist = nan(1,histLen);  eHist = nan(1,histLen);  dHist = nan(1,histLen);
%  SECTION 2 - GUI DESIGN (figure, panels, tabs, controls)
% Tab group on the right: equations + MATLAB function explanations
%  SECTION 3 - LaTeX INTEGRATION (equations drawn with the 'latex' interpreter)
% Each row: {y-position, text, interpreter, font size, weight}
0.79, 'Linearised model about the estimate (x^, y^, z^, b^)', 'tex',  12, 'bold'; ...

0.71, "$\Delta\rho_i=\mathbf{h}_i\,\Delta\mathbf{x},\ \ \mathbf{h}_i=\left[-\frac{x_i-\hat x}{\hat r_i},\,-\frac{y_i-\hat y}{\hat r_i},\,-\frac{z_i-\hat z}{\hat r_i},\,1\right]$", 'latex',14,'normal'; ...
0.03, 'c = speed of light, \delta t = receiver clock bias, \epsilon = noise, H = geometry matrix', 'tex', 9, 'normal'};
%  SECTION 5 - VISUALIZATION OBJECTS (3D scene + error plot)
% Satellite markers: visible (green) / below the horizon mask (grey)
% Pseudorange lines (one per satellite; only visible ones are shown)
title(ax3,'GPS constellation, user (red square), estimate (magenta x), pseudoranges (yellow)');
legend(ax3,[hSatVis hSatHid hUser hEst],{'Visible sat','Below mask','True user','Estimated'},'Location','northeast');
% Error and PDOP versus time (two y-axes)
%  SECTION 6 - SIMULATION LOGIC (callbacks, main loop, single time step)
while running && ishandle(fig)    % real-time animation loop
function onReset(~,~)                 % Reset time, user position and plots
function onClose(~,~)                 % Stop loop safely before closing
function onSelectDoc(src,~)           % Show selected function description
simT = 0;  lat = deg2rad(30);  lon = deg2rad(100);   % start point (editable)
tHist(:) = NaN;  eHist(:) = NaN;  dHist(:) = NaN;  trail(:) = NaN;
dt   = get(sWarp,'Value');        % simulated seconds per frame
% --- user motion on the sphere (constant speed and heading)
function drawFrame()                  % compute GPS solution + update graphics
ru = Re*[cos(lat)*cos(lon); cos(lat)*sin(lon); sin(lat)];   % true user ECEF
sprintf('Clock bias    : est %.1f us / true %.1f us    PDOP %.2f',xhat(4)/c*1e6,biasM/c*1e6,pdop) };
'Fewer than 4 satellites visible: no position fix.' };
tHist = [tHist(2:end), simT/60];  eHist = [eHist(2:end), err3];  dHist = [dHist(2:end), pdop];
%  SECTION 7 - LOCAL MATH FUNCTIONS (implementation of the GPS equations)
% Satellite positions in ECEF at time t [s]  (circular orbits).
%   u = u0 + n t ;  r_ECI = Rz(Omega) Rx(i) [R cos u; R sin u; 0]
% Elevation angle of every satellite and visibility flag.
% Pseudorange equation: rho_i = ||s_i - u|| + c*dt + eps_i
rho = r + biasM + sigma*randn(size(r)); % add clock bias [m] and noise
% Iterative least-squares solution for x = [X; Y; Z; b], b = c*dt.
% Rotation matrix from ECEF to local East-North-Up.
sl = sin(lat); cl = cos(lat); so = sin(lon); co = cos(lon);
% Text shown in the "MATLAB Functions" tab (explanation + code).
"Implements the circular-orbit equations. The argument of latitude";
"u = u0 + n*t advances with the mean motion n = sqrt(mu/R^3). The";
"orbit plane is tilted by inclination i and rotated by the RAAN Omega.";
"Finally the Earth rotation angle omegaE*t converts ECI to ECEF, so";
"satellites move relative to the rotating Earth.";
"The vector from user to satellite is d = s - u. Its component along";
"the local vertical (up) divided by its length is sin(elevation).";
"Satellites below the elevation mask are not used in the solution.";
"The geometric range is computed with sqrt/sum, the receiver clock";
"bias c*dt (metres) is common to all satellites, and eps_i is Gaussian";
"Gauss-Newton least squares. Unknowns: x = [X Y Z b] with b = c*dt.";
"Each iteration linearises the pseudorange equation: row i of H is";
"(r + b) is mapped to a state correction with the backslash operator,";
"which solves dx = (H'H)^-1 H' dRho in a numerically stable way (QR).";
"Q = (H'H)^-1 is the cofactor matrix returned by solveGPS. Its";
"diagonal terms scale the range error into position error. PDOP is";
"the square root of the trace of the 3x3 position block. Low PDOP =";
"satellites well spread in the sky = accurate fix.";
"The ECEF error vector (estimate - truth) is rotated into East, North,";
"Up components so that horizontal and vertical errors can be read.";
"A while-loop runs while the 'running' flag is true. Each pass:";
"  1. advances simulated time by the 'Time step' slider value;";
"  2. moves the user along the chosen heading and speed;";
"  4. builds pseudoranges and solves the position;";
"  5. updates line, marker and plot objects via set(...,'XData',...);";
"  6. drawnow limitrate; pause(0.02) refreshes the screen.";
"Updating existing graphics objects (instead of re-plotting) keeps";
"the animation fast. Rotate the 3D view with the mouse while it runs."];
